# Fragment Mono — local Latin subset

The Fragment Mono Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1, bundled beside
this file. Copied on 2026-10-28 from the WOFF2 face embedded in the Atelier
identity sheet (v1.0), which carries Google Fonts' Latin subset (regular 400).
The browser makes no runtime font request.

- Upstream: https://github.com/weiweihuanghuang/fragment-mono
- Used by `--studio-mono` in `gui/tokens.css`.
